summary.text: Bryan Logan is a Republican state senator from Oklahoma Senate District 8 who took office in May 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a pastor.

paragraphs.text: Logan defeated David Nelson in the April 1, 2025 special Republican primary runoff for District 8, then won the May 13, 2025 special general election over Democrat Nathan Brewer and independent Steve Sanford, with 61.6 percent of the vote.
He assumed office on May 21, 2025, and the June 16, 2026 Republican primary for the seat was canceled; Ballotpedia lists Brewer as his November opponent.
